Mid-rank percentile of a value among simulated replicates

replicate_percentile.Rd

100 * (mean(sim < x) + 0.5 * mean(sim == x)): the share of replicates below x, counting ties as half. Pass both sides on the scale a check uses; a value compared with rounded totals should be rounded the same way first, so a tie is a tie.

Usage

replicate_percentile(sim, x)

Arguments

sim

Numeric, one value per replicate. Non-finite values are dropped.

x

Numeric, the value(s) to place.

Value

Numeric, one percentile per element of x, or NA where x is not finite or sim holds no finite value.

See also

Other calibration plots: calibration_box_stats(), calibration_events(), calibration_plot_palette(), plot_calibration_area_by_fuel(), plot_calibration_convergence(), plot_calibration_fire_counts(), plot_calibration_fire_sizes(), plot_calibration_groups(), plot_calibration_loss(), plot_calibration_replicates(), plot_calibration_severity(), plot_calibration_severity_by_size(), plot_fire_regime_multipliers()

Examples

replicate_percentile(1:10, c(0.5, 5, 5.5, 11))
#> [1]   0  45  50 100
